blurb: Guests join small group wine tasting tours visiting multiple wineries and breweries in Niagara-on-the-Lake, Twenty Valley, and Beamsville Bench Wine regions. Tours include tastings, educational commentary on wine and the region, and some include meals or leisure time. Transportation is provided in a fleet of licensed luxury vehicles.
